about_the_game:
Become the Green Ninja. Step into the role of a swift, deadly warrior on a mission to cut down monsters, defeat powerful bosses, and uncover the darkness consuming the land. Wield your sword for close combat, your bow for precise ranged strikes, and master quick dashes and shield blocks to survive the onslaught.

Explore Diverse Biomes Venture across the vibrant Grasslands, scorching Desert, treacherous Underground, imposing Castle, and fiery depths of Hell. Each biome introduces unique enemies, hazards, and epic bosses that will push your ninja abilities to the limit.

Master Every Strike Your sword is swift, slicing through foes with precision. Your bow, silent yet deadly, delivers arrows to enemies before they even reach you. Switching between melee and ranged combat is key to surviving the onslaught, and every swing, shot, and block must be calculated.

Face Fearsome Bosses Each biome ends in a battle against a massive, cunning foe. Learn their patterns, strike at the perfect moment, and prove your skill as a true ninja.

Are you ready to become the ultimate ninja and vanquish every foe that stands in your way?

The Game is Made Entirely with GDevelop 5

Features:

  • Fluid ninja combat with melee and ranged weapons

  • Dynamic dash and shield mechanics for offense and defense

  • Epic boss fights that demand skill and patience

  • Multiple biomes with unique enemies and challenges

  • A journey from peaceful meadows to the blazing heart of darkness
